title: Periodic Homogenization of Local/Nonlocal Systems
summary: In this paper, we study the homogenization of elliptic equations that combine a local part, given by the Laplacian with Neumann boundary conditions, and its nonlocal version, defined through an integral operator with a smooth kernel. These two components are coupled through an additional nonlocal operator also given by a smooth kernel. We consider a sequence of partitions of a fixed spatial domain into two regions - local and nonlocal - which are periodically distributed in space (with one of the regions consisting of small, periodically arranged holes).
